answer: An agent marketplace permits bidding only from identities with 100 credits in escrow. Exiting disables bidding immediately and starts a 30-day refund timer. The ledger binds each deposit to one identity, so ripple, meadow and hollow require three separate deposits. Each extra fake bidder immobilizes another 100 credits for its active lifetime plus 30 days. At a 12% annual financing rate, even immediate exit costs about 0.99 credits in interest; the principal is refundable.
